description: Complete rebuild of the design token system and CSS architecture. This is the foundation that all other features depend on. Replaces the current fragmented 19-file CSS structure with a clean 7-file architecture. Rebuilds the color system from scratch with Navy Royal Blue primary, Muted Gold secondary, simplified spacing/radius/typography tokens, removes color-mix(), removes duplicate font families, and establishes proper dark/light themes with warm gray surfaces.
steps: Step 1: Create new frontend/src/styles/tokens.css from scratch with the complete new design token system. This file replaces the current tokens.css entirely. Include: (a) @layer declaration order. (b) Primary color Navy Royal Blue (#1E3A5F) with limited shades (50,100,200,300,400,500,600,700,800,900). (c) Secondary color Muted Gold (#C4A35A) with limited shades. (d) One accent color for notifications/actions (teal #2DA69E). (e) 4 semantic colors: success (#16a34a/#3DD68C), warning (#c2410c/#F5A623), error (#ba1a1a/#F55353), info (blue-based). (f) 10 neutral shades from white (#ffffff) to black (#0f1117). (g) Simple spacing: --sp-1 (4px), --sp-2 (8px), --sp-3 (12px), --sp-4 (16px), --sp-5 (24px), --sp-6 (32px), --sp-7 (48px), --sp-8 (64px). (h) Simple radius: --radius-sm (6px), --radius-md (10px), --radius-lg (16px), --radius-xl (24px), --radius-full (9999px). (i) Font sizes: base 16px, sm 14px, lg 18px, xl 24px, 2xl 32px, 3xl 40px, plus xxs 11px, xs 12px, md 15px for backward compat. (j) Only 2 fonts: --font-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; --font-mono: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace. (k) 3 shadows only: sm, md, lg. (l) Motion tokens (t-fast, t-base, t-slow, easing curves). (m) Layout tokens (sidebar-w: 240px, topbar-h: 56px, content-max-w: 1320px). (n) IMPORTANT: Maintain all backward-compatible aliases (--r-sm, --r-md, etc. mapping to new values) so existing class-based CSS doesn't break.

Step 2: In the same tokens.css file, define [data-theme='dark'] with warm gray surfaces per the spec: --bg: #1a1d23, --surface-1: #22262f, --surface-2: #292e38, --surface-3: #313742. Text: --text: #e8eaed, --text-muted: #9aa0a8, --text-subtle: #6b7280. Borders: rgba(255,255,255,0.06). Shadows max opacity 0.25. All semantic colors adjusted for dark mode readability. No color-mix() anywhere - use pre-computed hex/rgba values.

Step 3: In the same tokens.css file, define [data-theme='light'] with: --bg: #f8fafb, --surface-1: #ffffff, --surface-2: #f1f4f7, --surface-3: #e4e9ef. Text: --text: #1e2530, --text-muted: #4a5567, --text-subtle: #6b7a8d. Borders: #e4e9ef. Light shadows. All using direct color values (no color-mix).

Step 4: Create new frontend/src/styles/reset.css with a minimal CSS reset (box-sizing, margin/padding reset, img/svg max-width, button font-family inherit, -webkit-font-smoothing, etc.). Move the reset rules currently in base.css into this file.

Step 5: Rewrite frontend/src/styles/base.css to contain ONLY the layout shell: body styles, #root flex, .sidebar (width 240px), .topbar (height 56px), .main, .content, .content-inner, scrollbar styles. Remove all the old verbose declarations. No color-mix(). Reference only the new token names. Sidebar border uses var(--border). The sidebar brand, nav items, footer - all using the new simplified tokens.

Step 6: Rewrite frontend/src/styles/components.css to be the single file for ALL reusable UI components: cards (border-radius 12px, padding 20px, lighter shadows, subtle borders, hover = border-color change only), buttons (38px primary height, 34px secondary, border-radius 8px, font-weight 600), tables (thinner design, lower row height, quiet hover), badges, pills, tabs, inputs, progress bars, alerts, avatars, metrics, chat, posts, etc. Remove all color-mix() calls - replace with pre-computed rgba values. Keep all existing class names for backward compatibility.

Step 7: Create new frontend/src/styles/layout.css for grid helpers (.grid-2, .grid-3, .grid-4, etc.) and page structural classes (.page, .page-header, .page-title, .page-subtitle, etc.). Move these from components.css.

Step 8: Rewrite frontend/src/styles/landing.css as the COMPLETE landing page stylesheet. Consolidate content from: landing.css, landing-pro.css, landing-auth-v3.css, premium.css (landing-specific parts), stitch-canonical.css (landing-specific parts). The new landing follows the spec: Hero section (70-80vh, large Arabic title, gold CTA, optional subtle Islamic geometric pattern at 3-5% opacity), stats bar (4 numbers), features section (3-4 items), about section, final CTA. Large white spaces, elegant Arabic font for headings, limited colors. No color-mix(). Remove glassmorphism effects.

Step 9: Create frontend/src/styles/pages.css for dashboard-specific and internal page styles. Consolidate from: dashboard.css, owner.css, pdf.css, notifications.css. Remove all color-mix(). Simplify the welcome card, GPA card, progress cards to use the new restrained design language.

Step 10: Create frontend/src/styles/theme-dark.css with any dark-mode-only overrides that cannot be handled by the token swap in tokens.css (e.g., specific component-level adjustments). Keep this minimal - most theming should be through tokens.
Step 11: Create frontend/src/styles/theme-light.css with any light-mode-only overrides. Keep minimal.

Step 12: Update frontend/src/main.tsx to import the new CSS file structure in correct order: tokens.css, reset.css, base.css, layout.css, components.css, pages.css, landing.css, theme-dark.css, theme-light.css. Remove imports of deleted files (stitch-tokens.css, stitch-canonical.css, system.css, elevation.css, interactions.css, polish.css, premium.css, landing-pro.css, landing-auth-v3.css, utilities.css).
Step 13: Update frontend/index.html Google Fonts link to load ONLY: IBM Plex Sans Arabic (weights 300,400,500,600,700) and Space Mono (weights 400,700). Remove Lexend and Outfit.

Step 14: Ensure frontend/src/styles/responsive.css is updated to work with the new token names and file structure. This file handles all responsive breakpoints (375px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px). Remove all color-mix() calls. Keep all the responsive logic but reference new tokens.

Step 15: Delete the now-unused CSS files by emptying them (leave a comment saying consolidated): stitch-tokens.css (already empty), stitch-canonical.css, system.css, elevation.css, interactions.css, polish.css, premium.css, landing-pro.css, landing-auth-v3.css, utilities.css, notifications.css, owner.css, pdf.css, dashboard.css. We empty rather than delete to avoid any potential import errors during transition.
acceptance_criteria: tokens.css defines exactly ONE primary color family (Navy Royal Blue), ONE secondary (Muted Gold), ONE accent, 4 semantics, and 10 neutrals
No color-mix() function calls exist anywhere in any CSS file
Only 2 font families referenced: IBM Plex Sans Arabic and Space Mono
Dark theme uses warm gray backgrounds (#1a1d23, #22262f, #292e38, #313742) - never pure black
Spacing uses only --sp-1 through --sp-8 with values 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64px
Shadows limited to 3 levels: sm, md, lg
All backward-compatible aliases (--r-sm, --r-md, --r-lg, etc.) still resolve to valid values
main.tsx imports CSS in the correct cascade order
index.html loads only IBM Plex Sans Arabic + Space Mono from Google Fonts
CSS files total under 4000 lines (down from 12,394)
All existing CSS class names that are used in TSX files still have definitions
verification: Grep all CSS files for 'color-mix(' to confirm zero instances
Grep all CSS files for 'Lexend' and 'Outfit' to confirm removed
Verify main.tsx has valid import paths that correspond to existing CSS files
Count total CSS lines with wc -l to confirm significant reduction
findings: Successfully rebuilt from 19 CSS files (12,394 lines) to 7 active files (~2,400 lines). All color-mix() removed, only IBM Plex Sans Arabic + Space Mono fonts. All existing class names preserved. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY mode means no build/test verification possible - validated via grep checks for color-mix, font names, class existence, and token values.
